procedures.summary: Keep observations, correlations, hypotheses and reviewed conclusions distinct.
procedures.content: Use only host-returned events and source references as observations. Describe rule-derived links as correlations and retain the rule and evidence references. Record proposed explanations as hypotheses. Promote a claim to a reviewed conclusion only after an analyst review decision; preserve contradictions, missing coverage and clock uncertainty.

procedures.summary: Respect configured sources, case scope, time windows and analysis budgets.
procedures.content: Use only sources configured by the host and available in the current namespace or project scope. A case may have no time window. Never invent a window or require one solely to create a case. Apply the case time filter only when supplied; otherwise collect available matching data within declared page and execution budgets. Report incomplete coverage and retain continuation cursors. Treat truncated, timed-out or approximate search results as partial. Never infer that a missing event proves an event did not occur. For uploaded logs, prepare text and call investigate.log.import with an explicit JSONL or CSV field mapping. Use JSON pointers for nested JSON and exact headers for CSV. Preserve rejected records, missing timestamps and parser coverage. Continue bounded pages or resume host-saved progress; never treat a parsed page as complete case coverage. Keep original processor provenance separate from the parser profile.

procedures.summary: Trace an identity through authenticated destinations and nearby events.
procedures.content: Start with an exact user identifier, collect within the case window, then inspect authenticated_to relations and the source events behind each relation. Compare event times and host identity domains. Treat account-name matches across sources as separate unless the source supplies a stable shared identity.

procedures.summary: Trace observed communication while retaining direction and source evidence.
procedures.content: Start from a host or address, expand observed communication relations, inspect the supporting flow events, and compare source/destination fields and time coverage. A network edge establishes recorded communication only; it does not establish propagation, control or causality.

procedures.summary: Construct a time-ordered event chain with explicit clock limits.
procedures.content: Use the bounded temporal_path analysis for a candidate start and target. The host requires relation intervals to be time-compatible. Preserve unknown timestamps, uncertainty and clock limitations; a missing edge is not proof that the event did not occur. Use source-backed timestamps from selected documents and log sources. Preserve whether a time was reported in a document or recorded independently by a system. Do not treat a reported event as an independently observed event. Keep uncertainty and missing time links explicit. Import uploaded structured logs with investigate.log.import before using event algorithms. A document reported_event is a source statement, not an independent log event. Keep event time, reported time, document creation and collection time distinct. Use possible_same_event links only as explicit proposals backed by the anchored reported statement; do not rewrite event identities.

procedures.summary: Follow trace and message identifiers across integration events.
procedures.content: Use exact trace, span, correlation or message identifiers as the join key. Inspect the source event for each step and keep service-to-service ordering bounded by observed timestamps. Do not merge different identifiers based only on similar names or proximity in time.

procedures.summary: Test a proposed explanation against supporting and contradicting events.
procedures.content: State the claim as a hypothesis. Search for evidence that supports it and evidence that would contradict it, record limitations and alternative explanations, and leave the claim unreviewed. Only an analyst can decide whether a conclusion is accepted. Test the hypothesis against source-anchored supporting and contradicting statements and independently recorded events. Keep alternative explanations and unknown coverage explicit. Model comparisons remain proposals; only an authorized analyst can review a conclusion. Use supporting_statement_ids and contradicting_statement_ids for document evidence, separately from supporting_event_ids and contradicting_event_ids for normalized logs. A verified text anchor verifies the quoted text, not the truth of the reported event.

procedures.summary: Freeze a source-linked report from one exact case revision.
procedures.content: Confirm the case revision, then use investigate.report.compose. Preserve event ordering, rule IDs, evidence references, hypothesis state and gaps. The report is a frozen resource; further analysis creates a later case revision and a separately composed report. Freeze the exact case revision. Include each source type, retained content hash, processor version, source-anchored statements, comparisons and source dependencies. Distinguish reported events from independent log observations, preserve hypotheses and gaps, and keep the report immutable. Preserve actor candidates, anchored mentions, proposed evidence links, normalized event positions, parser profiles and import coverage in the frozen source manifest. Historical reports must retain their selected revision when new documents are added.

procedures.summary: Extract source-anchored actor mentions and keep identity matches provisional.
procedures.content: Read only explicitly selected case resources. Propose actor mentions with exact source resource, byte offsets, and verbatim quotes. Distinguish a mention from a resolved identity. Similar names across documents remain separate unless an explicit stable identifier or analyst review supports a binding. Record proposals with investigate.statement.record only after preparing the source text. Supply statement mentions with exact names and absolute UTF-8 byte offsets inside the statement quote. The host creates distinct actor candidates and mention IDs even for equal names. Read actors and actor_mentions through investigate.case.items before proposing possible_same_actor evidence_links. Links require supporting statement IDs and rationale; they do not merge candidates or constitute analyst review.

procedures.summary: Compare source-anchored statements while distinguishing contradiction, qualification, dependency, and uncertainty.
procedures.content: Extract the relevant statements from selected sources with exact anchors. Compare only statements that address compatible actors, events, time ranges, places, and definitions. Mark contradictions only when the statements make incompatible claims under those conditions. Record source citation or retelling as dependency when supported; do not count dependent accounts as independent corroboration. Preserve unresolved comparisons as inconclusive. Compare newly selected sources with earlier saved statements explicitly chosen for this analysis. Use investigate.analyze source_followup for a bounded structural list of unprocessed sources and unexamined source pairs; suggestions are not semantic matches or executable tool calls. A possible_same_event evidence_link may connect a reported_event statement to a selected normalized log event; it remains a proposal and preserves both observations.

procedures.summary: Describe document origin and processing facts without inferring authenticity from writing style.
procedures.content: Inspect host-provided metadata, content hashes, original resource references, processor versions, and available version lineage. Separate verified integrity and processing facts from model-proposed anomalies. Missing metadata is an information gap, not evidence of manipulation. OCR anchors refer to the OCR text representation and do not establish image content beyond that representation.

procedures.summary: Bounded source preparation and analysis handoff.
procedures.content: Carry forward the selected case revision, source IDs and versions, question, evidence references, coverage and unresolved limits. Inspect saved items first and reuse sufficient prepared evidence from those source versions; do not repeat collection merely because a new turn started. For documents, use the retained text representation and verified anchors; for uploaded logs, use an explicit parser mapping and bounded import; for configured search sources, use scoped collection and host cursors. Choose only the paths needed by the selected sources. Each phase records its result or an explicit limitation. Preserve proposed links and analyst review status. Report Findings, Evidence, Coverage and Limitations, with Next step only when needed. Source preparation is constrained by host-resolved selected source kinds: search collection requires a search connector, log import requires an uploaded log source, and document preparation or statement extraction requires retained document or log text. Unknown readiness is a limitation, not permission to assume a source type. Source attachment remains an explicit separate action.

procedures.summary: Evidence-bound, resumable investigation phases with scoped follow-up.
procedures.content: Use the bound executable method when available. A blueprint without a bound workflow remains a planning template. Inspect retained source versions before acquisition; reuse sufficient evidence. Select only an available declared continuation based on verified observations and the user question. Follow-up collection, document inspection and hypothesis formulation may happen after the primary analysis, within the same scope and budget. A hypothesis is a proposal, not approval or causality. Evidence IDs and source positions must come from actual tool results. Never retry unknown evidence as a revision conflict. Preserve explicit partial coverage, unknown times, contradictions and missing links. If an identity or source is ambiguous, seek clarification rather than inventing a binding. Report Findings, Evidence, Coverage and Limitations. A limited result must state what could not be established; an empty page does not establish absence.

transitions.model_instruction: Open the explicitly selected existing case. Do not replace its identity or revision.
Create a case when no existing case is selected and the requested investigation needs one, including continuation after an earlier case-creation failure. Use only explicitly chosen sources and scope.
Choose the existing case from the verified list that matches the request. Ask for clarification when ambiguous.

choices.description: Use retained observations when they cover the selected source versions and question.

Prepare missing retained document text before inspecting it.
Read an already prepared document representation needed for this analysis.
Attach a user-selected source only when it is not already in this case.

Persist a user-requested case time window only when it differs from the current verified case scope. If already saved, continue evidence acquisition or analysis. Temporary acquisition or analysis filters do not require a case update.
No sources exist and none are available: report the missing underlay explicitly.

transitions.model_instruction: Choose from actual source kinds, versions, processing status and retained coverage. Do not reacquire sufficient evidence or add an existing source again. Read collection_context pages as query-specific receipts. Reuse a sufficient completed query; when a receipt has a next_cursor, request that next page only if the question needs it. A new question or different identifier can justify a new query; source-level query_complete alone is not complete coverage of every question. Start from any known source field, machine, account, address or time hint. No user ID or time window is required. Choose further filters from actual evidence; preserve distinct query provenance when pivoting. Missing identifiers allow bounded source discovery. Changing a temporary filter does not change the saved case scope.

Use the exact identity, trace or other identifier established by the question and evidence. Do not substitute an unrelated IP. Preserve partial coverage. Inspect the selected source collection_context. For a continuation, copy the issued next_cursor and its query_parameters exactly. Omit cursor only for a new query; omit idempotency_key unless intentionally refreshing the same query. Reused pages are already inspected acquisition evidence, not new progress. Identifier filters are optional and may target any configured field, not only users. Query time bounds are optional and temporary; omit them to inherit case scope. Do not invent an identifier or time range.
Use the retained log source, declared parser and host continuation cursor; do not guess its mapping.
Prepare only a selected source lacking a usable retained text representation.
Read the actual authorized representation URI returned by source inspection or preparation. Preserve source positions and truncation.
Use an explicitly selected provider or resource reference, never an invented source or implicit attachment.

Record only observations anchored in the text actually read. Preserve exact verified positions, proposed actor links, source dependence, contradictions and incomplete extraction. Reuse stable identities and supply a retry-safe idempotency key.
Inspect events for the exact investigated entity or trace and optional time window. Keep failure, unknown outcome and time uncertainty visible.

blueprints.selection_description: Trace an identity through hosts and authentication events.
blueprints.purpose: Establish which configured sources record authentication activity for the selected identity.
blueprints.goal: Produce a source-linked account of observed authentication destinations and related events.
blueprints.success_criteria: Every stated destination is supported by retained source events; uncertain identity bindings and coverage gaps remain explicit.

steps.title: Select scope
steps.objective: Confirm exact identity, selected sources, case revision and optional time window. Missing time bounds allow bounded inspection of available matching data. Result: scope and unresolved identity bindings.

steps.title: Prepare source observations
steps.objective: Inspect saved items for the selected source versions first. Prepare only missing evidence: retained text and anchors for documents, mapped bounded import for uploaded logs, or scoped paginated collection for search sources. Result: prepared source references, coverage, rejected records and unknown times; reuse sufficient evidence.

steps.title: Collect events
steps.objective: Collect only missing records matching the exact identity within scope. Result: retained event references, current revision and page coverage; do not recollect a sufficient imported page.

steps.title: Inspect relations
steps.objective: Expand authentication relations and inspect their source events. Result: observed destinations with event references and identity-domain limits.

steps.title: Report findings
steps.objective: Report observed destinations, supporting events, uncertain identities and coverage gaps. Keep explanations separate as hypotheses.

blueprints.selection_description: Trace observed network communication from a host or address.
blueprints.purpose: Describe source-linked communication paths and their time coverage.
blueprints.goal: Identify the observed peers and supporting flow records for the selected host or address.
blueprints.success_criteria: Relations retain their derivation rule and event evidence; communication is not presented as causation.

steps.objective: Confirm selected host/address, sources, case revision and time range. Result: exact scope and source-specific identity.

steps.title: Prepare source observations
steps.objective: Inspect saved items for the selected source versions first. Prepare only missing evidence: retained text and anchors for documents, mapped bounded import for uploaded logs, or scoped paginated collection for search sources. Result: prepared source references, coverage, rejected records and unknown times; reuse sufficient evidence.

steps.title: Collect flow events
steps.objective: Collect only missing scoped flow records. Result: retained source/destination events, current revision and page coverage.

steps.title: Expand peers
steps.objective: Inspect peers and the events behind each relation. Result: directed communication edges with derivation rules and evidence.

steps.title: Qualify coverage
steps.objective: Report observed peers, direction, time coverage and truncation. Communication alone establishes neither propagation nor causality.

blueprints.selection_description: Find a bounded time-compatible chain between two entities.
blueprints.purpose: Test whether recorded relations form a time-ordered path under explicit bounds.
blueprints.goal: Return a bounded shortest-hop temporal path or an explicit no-path/budget-limited result.
blueprints.success_criteria: Every path edge has source events and compatible event times; incomplete searches are marked partial.

steps.title: Define endpoints
steps.objective: Select source-bound start and target identities, case revision and earliest allowed event time. Result: explicit endpoints, time uncertainty and search bounds.

steps.title: Prepare source observations
steps.objective: Inspect saved items for the selected source versions first. Prepare only missing evidence: retained text and anchors for documents, mapped bounded import for uploaded logs, or scoped paginated collection for search sources. Result: prepared source references, coverage, rejected records and unknown times; reuse sufficient evidence.

steps.title: Collect relations
steps.objective: Acquire only missing source records needed for candidate edges. Result: retained event references and coverage; reported document events remain distinct from log observations.

steps.title: Search chain
steps.objective: Run bounded temporal_path on the selected evidence. Result: a source-backed time-compatible path or the returned no-path, insufficient-data or budget stop status.

steps.title: Inspect proof
steps.objective: Inspect supporting event times and references. Report the returned optimality status, clock limits and coverage; an exhausted bounded search is not proof that no real-world chain exists.

blueprints.selection_description: Follow an exact trace, correlation or message identifier across services.
blueprints.purpose: Reconstruct an integration path from source events that share a stable trace identifier.
blueprints.goal: Describe the observed service/event sequence with its timestamps and source evidence.
blueprints.success_criteria: The path uses exact identifier matches, preserves missing spans and does not invent unobserved service transitions.

steps.title: Select identifier
steps.objective: Confirm exact trace, span, correlation or message identifier, selected sources, case revision and time range. Result: scoped join keys without guessed identity equivalences.

steps.title: Prepare source observations
steps.objective: Inspect saved items for the selected source versions first. Prepare only missing evidence: retained text and anchors for documents, mapped bounded import for uploaded logs, or scoped paginated collection for search sources. Result: prepared source references, coverage, rejected records and unknown times; reuse sufficient evidence.

steps.title: Collect spans
steps.objective: Collect only missing exact-identifier matches. Result: retained spans/events, current revision and coverage.

steps.title: Order events
steps.objective: Inspect the time-ordered service path from retained events. Result: source-backed steps, identifiers and explicit missing links.

steps.title: State gaps
steps.objective: Report observed sequence, evidence, missing spans, uncertain clocks and unsupported transitions.

blueprints.selection_description: Evaluate a testable claim against supporting and contradicting evidence.
blueprints.purpose: Keep an explanation as a hypothesis until an analyst reviews the evidence.
blueprints.goal: Record a hypothesis with both supporting and contradicting source references and explicit limitations.
blueprints.success_criteria: The claim remains a hypothesis; model output never records an analyst review decision.

steps.title: State claim
steps.objective: State a testable explanation, alternatives and what evidence would distinguish them. Result: selected case revision, hypothesis identity when existing, sources and scope.

steps.title: Seek support
steps.objective: Inspect existing scoped statements and events, then acquire missing support only when authorized and available. Result: supporting statement/event IDs and coverage limits.

steps.title: Seek contradictions
steps.objective: Examine evidence that challenges the claim and alternative explanations. Result: contradicting IDs, dependent sources, unresolved questions and any unavailable checks; absence is not disproof.

steps.title: Record hypothesis
steps.objective: Reuse an adequate saved hypothesis without writing it again; otherwise record a new unique claim_id with separate supporting and contradicting statement/event IDs. Result: hypothesis reference, current revision, alternatives and limitations. The recording tool does not update existing claims; preserve their review state.

blueprints.selection_description: Create or refresh a frozen investigation report, optionally saving a user-requested case time scope first. Other analysis or acquisition requires a broader investigation route.
blueprints.purpose: Create an auditable report resource tied to one immutable case revision.
blueprints.goal: Produce a source-linked report containing a timeline, relations, hypotheses and coverage limitations.
blueprints.success_criteria: Any requested case time scope is saved and verified before report composition. The report URI and fingerprint identify the resulting frozen case revision; retained evidence is preserved.

steps.title: Confirm revision
steps.objective: Open the selected case, compare its current saved scope with any requested scope change, and persist only a missing user-requested change before freezing a report. Preserve retained evidence and verify the resulting revision.

steps.title: Compose report
steps.objective: Use investigate.report.compose for the selected revision. Result: frozen report resource and fingerprint preserving source versions, processing provenance, evidence, hypotheses and gaps.

steps.title: Review report
steps.objective: Read the created report and verify references and claim states against the selected revision. Result: report reference with Findings, Evidence, Coverage and Limitations; unresolved issues require a later revision, not silent alteration.

blueprints.selection_description: Analyze selected actors or event entities through source-anchored text or retained event relations.
blueprints.purpose: Describe supported actor mentions and event-entity relationships while retaining identity uncertainty.
blueprints.goal: Produce a source-linked relationship analysis using the selected case evidence representation.
blueprints.success_criteria: Text anchors are host-verified; event links retain supporting records. Proposed actor identity remains unreviewed and distinct from event entity identity.

steps.title: Select sources
steps.objective: Confirm case revision, selected source identities and the actor or entity question. Preserve source-local identity domains.

steps.title: Prepare evidence
steps.objective: Reuse sufficient retained query receipts, event pages or document representations. Acquire only missing evidence and preserve the issued continuation position.

steps.title: Inspect actors and entities
steps.objective: Select text-anchored mention analysis or event-backed entity relations according to the available evidence and question. Preserve exact IDs and provenance; do not turn event entities into reviewed actors.

steps.title: Qualify identities
steps.objective: Separate observed event relationships, source-anchored mentions and proposed identity links. Report evidence and coverage limits; analyst review remains host-authorized.

blueprints.selection_description: Compare event descriptions and statements across selected documents and logs.
blueprints.purpose: Find supported agreement, contradiction, qualification, source dependency, and unresolved differences.
blueprints.goal: Record comparable source-anchored statements and explicitly qualified pairwise comparisons.
blueprints.success_criteria: Comparisons cite verified statements, retain source dependency and time uncertainty, and do not equate missing records with disproof.

steps.title: Select sources
steps.objective: Choose case revision, documents/log sources and the specific event or claim to compare. Result: bounded source selection and comparison question, not every possible source pair.

steps.title: Prepare source observations
steps.objective: Inspect saved items for the selected source versions first. Prepare only missing evidence: retained text and anchors for documents, mapped bounded import for uploaded logs, or scoped paginated collection for search sources. Result: prepared source references, coverage, rejected records and unknown times; reuse sufficient evidence.

steps.title: Extract statements
steps.objective: Reuse existing statements and extract missing comparable claims. Result: exact wording, verified source anchors, actors, reported times and separate independent log observations.

steps.title: Compare accounts
steps.objective: Check whether selected accounts concern compatible actors, places, definitions and times before comparing. Result: anchored agreement, contradiction, qualification, dependency or inconclusive comparison; dependent retellings are not independent support.

steps.title: State limits
steps.objective: Report compared claims, evidence, source dependencies, unaligned clocks and incomplete coverage. A verified quote does not verify the reported event.

steps.title: Identify incremental work
steps.objective: If unresolved work remains, inspect bounded source_followup suggestions for selected old/new sources. Result: unexamined sources or pairs as possible next work, not asserted matches or automatic tool execution.

blueprints.selection_description: Inspect origin, versions, and processing history of selected investigation documents.
blueprints.purpose: Summarize verifiable metadata and representation lineage for the case sources.
blueprints.goal: Produce a source-by-source provenance account with explicit metadata gaps and processor history.
blueprints.success_criteria: Integrity facts and processing provenance are host-derived; model-proposed anomalies are not presented as verified manipulation.

steps.title: Select sources
steps.objective: Confirm case revision and exact retained resources under review. Result: source identities and versions.

steps.title: Inspect origin
steps.objective: Inspect host-provided hashes, scope, original references and lineage. Result: verifiable integrity/metadata facts and missing fields, not a general authenticity verdict.

steps.title: Inspect processing
steps.objective: Inspect saved processor and OCR representations without reprocessing unchanged sources. Result: versions, representation lineage, coverage and anchor limitations.

steps.title: Report gaps
steps.objective: Report verified metadata and processing facts separately from proposed anomalies and unanswered authenticity questions. Missing metadata is not proof of manipulation.

artifact_profiles.title: Investigation report
artifact_profiles.purpose: Present one immutable mixed-source case revision with traceable documents, logs, statements, analyses, supported and contradicted claims, and explicit gaps.

sections.title: Scope and method
sections.purpose: Identify the case revision, all source types and versions, applicable time window, and analysis methods.

sections.title: Timeline
sections.purpose: List recorded and reported events in time order while retaining source type, unknown times, and uncertainty.

sections.title: Relations
sections.purpose: Describe observed and rule-derived links with their evidence and derivation rules.

sections.title: Claims and alternatives
sections.purpose: Separate source statements, hypotheses, proposed comparisons and reviewed conclusions; include support, contradiction and source dependency.

sections.title: Gaps and limitations
sections.purpose: Record partial extraction, unavailable OCR, missing metadata, incomplete coverage, and unresolved questions.
